name: Cohere
description: Provides Command models for chat, RAG, and tool use, plus Embed and Rerank models for search, via a REST API and Python, TypeScript, Java, and Go SDKs for enterprise developers.

skills.name: Chat and Generation
skills.description: Generates text and multi-turn chat replies with Command models through the Chat API, including streamed event output.

skills.name: Tool Use
skills.description: Lets Command models call developer-defined tools and return structured tool calls for building agents and workflows.

skills.name: Text Embeddings
skills.description: Converts text and images into vector embeddings with Embed models for semantic search, clustering, and classification.

skills.name: Document Reranking
skills.description: Reorders a list of documents by relevance to a query with Rerank models to improve search and RAG retrieval quality.
